recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一顆大型組織球，淡染細胞質內包含多顆完整的小淋巴球，周圍有空暈（emperipolesis），背景有漿細胞與淋巴球浸潤於纖維性基質中，為 Rosai-Dorfman 病的特徵。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing multiple intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis, arrow)
Engulfed lymphocytes surrounded by clear halos within the histiocyte cytoplasm
Other histiocytes with vesicular nuclei, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Plasma cells and small lymphocytes in background
describe_en: High-power sections show large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm in a fibrous stroma with admixed plasma cells and lymphocytes. One histiocyte contains numerous intact lymphocytes within its cytoplasm, each surrounded by a clear halo (emperipolesis, arrow). The engulfed cells appear viable without evidence of degradation. Findings are characteristic of Rosai-Dorfman disease, here in an extranodal site.

ddx.vs: HLH macrophages show true phagocytosis with degraded cells and are S100 negative, whereas emperipolesis in RDD preserves intact lymphocytes in S100+ histiocytes.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophil-rich background, and CD1a/langerin positivity without emperipolesis.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact lymphocytes and are S100 negative.
